coach.header.subtitle: Your Health Coach
coach.step1.question: Do you want me to help you?
coach.step1.context: I looked at your results. What you are going through is real — and it is fixable. But only if you actually want to change something.
coach.step2.question: Will you follow my recommendations — even when it feels hard?
coach.step2.context: I will not ask you to quit your job or turn your life upside down. But I will ask you to do one specific thing each week. That is the deal.
coach.step2.yes: Yes, I will follow your guidance
coach.step3.question: Will you be honest with me — even when it is uncomfortable?
coach.step3.context: I can only help with what I actually know. The more honest you are, the better your plan will be. That is all I ask.
coach.step3.yes: Yes, I will be honest with you
coach.name.context: Before we start — I want to know who I am talking to. Not an email. Not a username.
coach.name.subtitle: one more thing
coach.name.question: What should I call you?
coach.committed: You are committed, {{name}}. Let us figure this out together.
coach.chat.opening:
Hi {{name}}. Let us start.

One question — and I want you to be specific:

What is taking the most out of you right now? Not what you think you should say. What is actually draining you.

coach.plan.subtitle: Based on everything you shared with me
alex.header.subtitle: AI Finance Coach
alex.step1.context: Most people never reach financial freedom because they lack a clear system. I will help you build one — step by step, starting from exactly where you are.
alex.step1.question: Are you ready to take control of your financial future?
alex.step2.context: Understanding your money habits is the first step to changing them. I've seen people transform their finances in 90 days simply by tracking where their money actually goes.
alex.step2.question: Will you commit to building a clear financial picture this week?
alex.step3.context: Your financial plan needs to be built around your actual life — your income, your goals, your timeline. Cookie-cutter advice doesn't work. Your plan will be made for you.
alex.step3.question: Ready to get your personalized financial plan?
alex.name.subtitle: Personal Finance Coach
alex.name.context: I'll start by understanding your current financial situation — no judgment, just clarity. Then together we'll build a realistic path forward.
alex.name.question: What's your first name?
alex.chat.opening: Hi {name}! I'm Alex, your personal finance coach. I've looked at your results and I'm here to help you take real action. What's your biggest financial challenge right now?
alex.plan.subtitle: Based on your situation and goals, I've built a personalized action plan.
alex.committed: You're committed to your financial transformation, {name}
